mapper.sql: s.sampling_plan_id, s.plan_cd, s.plan_nm, s.method, s.fixed_n, s.pct, s.std_cd, s.insp_level, s.severity, s.aql, s.ac, s.re, s.sort_no, s.use_yn, s.remark, s.row_ver, s.updated_at, s.updated_by, (select count(distinct p.insp_plan_id) from qms_insp_plan_line l join qms_insp_plan p on p.insp_plan_id = l.insp_plan_id where l.sampling_plan_id = s.sampling_plan_id and p.status <> 'DRAFT') as locked_cnt, (select count(distinct p.insp_plan_id) from qms_insp_plan_line l join qms_insp_plan p on p.insp_plan_id = l.insp_plan_id where l.sampling_plan_id = s.sampling_plan_id and p.status = 'DRAFT') as draft_cnt

from qms_sampling_plan s
and (s.plan_cd ilike #{q.keywordLike} escape '\' or s.plan_nm ilike #{q.keywordLike} escape '\') and s.method = #{q.method} and s.use_yn = 'Y'

order by
s.plan_cd s.plan_nm s.method s.sort_no s.updated_at
desc,
s.sampling_plan_id
mapper.select: select from qms_sampling_plan s where s.sampling_plan_id = #{id}
select from qms_sampling_plan s where s.plan_cd = #{planCd}
select from qms_sampling_plan s where s.use_yn = 'Y' order by s.sort_no, s.plan_cd

insert into qms_sampling_plan (comp_cd, plan_cd, plan_nm, method, fixed_n, pct, std_cd, insp_level, severity, aql, ac, re, sort_no, use_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.planCd}, #{f.planNm}, #{f.method}, #{f.fixedN}, #{f.pct}, #{f.stdCd}, #{f.inspLevel}, #{f.severity}, #{f.aql}, #{f.ac}, #{f.re}, #{f.sortNo}, #{f.useYn}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning sampling_plan_id
select std_cd from qms_aql_table union select std_cd from qms_aql_plan_row order by 1

select aql_table_id, std_cd, insp_level, lot_from, lot_to, code_letter, use_yn, row_ver from qms_aql_table where std_cd = #{stdCd} and use_yn = 'Y' order by array_position(array['I','II','III','S1','S2','S3','S4']::varchar[], insp_level), lot_from

select aql_row_id, std_cd, severity, code_letter, aql, sample_size, ac, re, use_yn, row_ver from qms_aql_plan_row where std_cd = #{stdCd} and use_yn = 'Y' order by array_position(array['NORMAL','TIGHTENED','REDUCED']::varchar[], severity), code_letter, aql
select exists (select 1 from qms_aql_table where std_cd = #{stdCd} and insp_level = #{inspLevel} and use_yn = 'Y')
select exists (select 1 from qms_aql_plan_row where std_cd = #{stdCd} and severity = #{severity} and aql = #{aql} and use_yn = 'Y')
